speaker: charlie
text: Right here at the Gabba this arvo, Fremantle showed why they're genuine premiership contenders, defeating the Lions 103 to 78. The Dockers were absolutely magnificent with their tall forwards Jye Amiss and Patrick Voss both kicking four goals each.

speaker: alice
text: It was Fremantle's 11th win in a row which is seriously impressive form. Unfortunately for our Lions, that's three straight defeats now and they're sitting at six wins and six losses, which has coach Chris Fagan under a bit of pressure.

speaker: charlie
text: The Dockers led by 51 points at one stage before the Lions rallied in the final quarter to make it more respectable. Great to see the Gabba crowd supporting the FightMND cause today as well - every bit helps with that vital research.
